evals.prompt: 当前 attempt plan 声明 Composition: tickets=true, dag=false。请恢复执行，不要为了索引 ticket 状态创建 dag.md。
evals.expected_output: Uses same-Attempt-ID ticket files as runtime/acceptance sources, keeps plan task-free, and does not create a DAG.
expectations: Reads Composition from the current attempt plan
Distinguishes Publication Status from Runtime Acceptance Status
Does not create dag.md or a plan task checklist
Requires every ticket AC to have an evidence producer or manual owner
Requires the earned plan-decomposition bundle to be approved before execution

evals.prompt: 当前 attempt plan 声明 Composition: tickets=false, dag=true，引用 S2 的 spec:AC-1 到 AC-3。请恢复并继续执行。
evals.expected_output: Uses the current attempt DAG as task state and keeps acceptance evidence in spec ACs, the plan Execution Record and gate entries without creating tickets.
expectations: Reads Composition and P revision from the current plan
Uses spec:AC-n targets
Does not create progress without a Task-specific trigger
Appends actual verification to the current plan Execution Record
Requires the current DAG to be part of the approved earned bundle before selecting a Task

evals.prompt: 当前 attempt 为 tickets=true, dag=true；T3 contributes-to checkout 并依赖 T2。T2 因上游返工重开。恢复后能直接继续 T3 吗？
evals.expected_output: Reconciles evidence, marks T3 and dependent evidence NEEDS-REVALIDATION, and does not infer ticket acceptance from old task completion.
expectations: Uses deterministic readiness resolution
Treats NEEDS-REVALIDATION as non-releasing
Keeps ticket acceptance canonical in the ticket file
Requires new direct AC evidence

evals.prompt: T1 DONE，T2 因外部 gate BLOCKED，T3 无 blocker，T4 依赖已有替代证据的 WAIVED T1。恢复后如何选下一单元？
evals.expected_output: Filters the static graph deterministically and selects the first actionable unit in document order without dispatching workers.
expectations: Treats DONE and evidenced WAIVED as dependency-releasing
Treats BLOCKED as non-releasing
Uses stable document order
Does not introduce frontier scheduling, leasing or automatic assignment

evals.prompt: 准备写 terminal gate entry：有两个 durable delta，其中一个目标 module spec 不存在。应按什么顺序完成 Stage 7 和 append-only 写入？
evals.expected_output: Reserves the next G id, fixes comparison/evidence anchors, completes pending registration, truth pointers and required stub, then inserts the immutable terminal entry once.
expectations: Uses <destination>|<delta-id> as the dedupe key
Creates a required target spec stub before its truth pointer
Does not append a temporary gate entry and edit it later
Records none plus a reason only when no durable delta exists

evals.prompt: 一个 tickets=false, dag=true attempt 有跨模块 seam。说明 integration responsibility、证据位置和关闭限制。
evals.expected_output: Keeps seam contract and acceptance ownership in spec, Working Branch owner integration responsibility, and actual acceptance evidence in the plan Execution Record/gate.
expectations: Reads contract owner, acceptance owner and affected targets from spec
Uses the existing Working Branch owner for the integration step
Blocks closure until affected spec AC evidence is accepted
Does not copy the seam contract into plan or DAG

evals.prompt: 活动 attempt P1 原本 tickets=false, dag=false，执行中发现必须拆成两个独立验收 slice，但 D1/S1 行为合同不变。如何升级？
evals.expected_output: Routes to impl-planning for P2 and current-attempt artifact relocation while keeping D1/S1 unchanged and avoiding dual writable state.
expectations: Treats Composition as plan-owned attempt state
Does not rerun Decision or Spec Gate without contract drift
Records previous/new Composition and artifact relocation
Does not create a per-ticket patch plan

evals.prompt: 已关闭 package 的新 implementation-only patch plan 声明 Composition: tickets=false, dag=false；只有一个 adapter 修复、无 seam、无依赖。请恢复执行。
evals.expected_output: Executes the simple patch without a task checklist, DAG or progress ledger, and appends verification to Execution Record.
expectations: Does not inherit the historical attempt DAG
Does not create T<n> state or a plan checklist
Reuses current D/S revisions for implementation-only drift
Appends actual checks and results under stable ER anchors

evals.prompt: Attempt patch-a 的最新 gate entry 是 patch-a-G1 blocked。补齐 ER-3 证据后准备 pass；请更新 gate。
evals.expected_output: Leaves the old entry unchanged and inserts patch-a-G2 pass at the top with Supersedes: patch-a-G1 and an Evidence link to the plan ER entry.
expectations: Preserves the old entry byte-for-byte
Uses the next unused same-attempt G number
Links Supersedes to patch-a-G1
Freezes the plan only after the terminal entry is written

evals.prompt: Gate entry initial-G1 passed Decision D1 / Spec S1。之后行为合同升级为 S2。能否用 initial-G1 证明 S2 已通过 implementation gate？
evals.expected_output: No. The S1 gate entry proves only S1; S2 needs new plan/evidence and a new gate evaluation tied to S2.
expectations: Does not reinterpret or edit initial-G1
Treats the revision fields as part of the verdict identity
Creates a new patch attempt if the earlier attempt was terminal

evals.prompt: 本次变更受 Data Safety、UI Evidence 与 Real Route Safety policy 约束。请记录验证并写 gate。
evals.expected_output: The plan references policy and records only selected checks plus actual results in append-only Execution Record; gate stores only evidence anchors, verdict summary and Durable Deltas.
expectations: Does not copy the generic policy checklist into plan
Does not copy a full verification checklist into gate
Keeps commands/results/evidence in plan ER entries
Keeps gate limited to revision-bound decision metadata

evals.prompt: execution-findings.md 中混有一个设计选择、一个规范性失败恢复规则、一条长期项目知识和一次测试命令结果。gate 前如何处理？
evals.expected_output: Routes decision choice to decision, normative behavior to spec, durable knowledge to gate/_pending, and test evidence to plan Execution Record while retaining only residual confirmed execution findings in execution-findings.md.
expectations: Does not leave a second contract SoT in execution-findings.md
Reruns only the gates required by the classified drift
Does not put process evidence into decision or spec

evals.prompt: 适用 review、execution findings 分流和 Stage 7 已完成，准备写 terminal pass；测试证据来自当前 feature worktree，但最后又提交了 gate metadata，随后将合入 dev。应怎样收口并声明 closed？
evals.expected_output: Runs verification-before-completion before terminal pass, then audits again after metadata/target-branch changes before claiming closed, reusing unaffected evidence and rerunning only checks invalidated by the delta.
expectations: Does not model verification-before-completion as a DAG task
Blocks terminal pass when claim evidence is stale or incomplete
Reuses evidence whose revision and environment provenance remain valid
Rechecks final HEAD, clean state and target-branch integration before the closed claim

evals.prompt: package 中有 plan.md 和 patch plan；旧文件还写着 Status: Draft。内部 .impl-package/revision-bindings.json 的 current.attempt 指向 patch/P2，且该 blob 与 HEAD:path 相符，旧 attempt 已有 terminal pass。恢复时哪个 attempt 是 Active？
evals.expected_output: Ignores manually written plan status, derives the patch as the only Active attempt from the registry and gate ledger, and treats the old attempt as Frozen.
expectations: Uses the internal sidecar current selection rather than a plan Status field
Verifies the selected plan blob against Git
Derives the old attempt as Frozen from its terminal gate
Stops on duplicate or missing current bindings instead of guessing by time

evals.prompt: Planned Verification 要教授手动验收一个本地 UI，环境已经启动。请在等待他测试前给出 handoff；没有 seed identity，也没有 mock 边界。
evals.expected_output: Produces a lightweight readiness packet with the required user story, shortest entry path, pass/fail observations and feedback owner, adding only relevant optional environment/teardown fields.
expectations: Includes all four required readiness fields
Selects only relevant optional fields
Does not emit N/A placeholders for seed or mock fields
Records the packet in the latest ER or canonical handoff rather than creating a new package artifact

evals.prompt: 当前 comparison point 已经进入 dev，但 attempt 还没有 terminal gate，plan 也没有 owner-approved pre-gate integration 记录。现在能否称 closed？
evals.expected_output: Reports Integrated, gate open, flags the missing integration-order authorization, and blocks closed until target-branch evidence and the terminal gate are complete.
expectations: Treats Integrated, gate open as a derived qualifier rather than a writable status
Does not equate merge with gate closure
Flags the absent owner-approved pre-gate integration strategy
Requires final evidence from the target branch

evals.prompt: 请向 owner 汇报当前 package：D2/S3/P1 binding 校验通过，patch attempt 为 Active，尚未进入 dev。内部 sidecar 是 JSON。
evals.expected_output: Produces a self-contained Markdown handoff with the revision set, binding conclusion, derived lifecycle and integration state without requiring the owner to open the JSON sidecar or re-approve an already Active attempt.
expectations: Reports D2 / S3 / P1 and binding validation in readable Markdown
Reports Active and the not-integrated state directly
Does not expose raw JSON as the primary handoff
Mentions the sidecar only as optional machine audit metadata, if at all
Does not invent a new owner approval gate after lifecycle is already Active

evals.prompt: 恢复一个 approved attempt。下一 actionable unit 修改 cursor pagination 和并发 claim；Spec 已定义边界，但 Planned Verification 只有‘补测试’，没有测试入口、oracle 或 ER evidence owner。请开始执行。
evals.expected_output: Blocks only the affected high-risk unit, invalidates the current bundle approval as required for planned-evidence changes, and routes the verification-design gap to impl-planning without inventing execution-time cases or IDs.
expectations: Runs the high-risk verification-readiness guard before execution or dispatch
Routes to impl-planning because the behavior contract already exists
Does not create a case matrix, mandatory IDs or a second plan
Does not redefine the gap inside a subagent dispatch prompt

evals.prompt: 恢复一个 approved attempt。下一 actionable unit 是单 owner、局部可逆的文案修正，现有局部测试和 ER owner 已明确。请继续执行。
evals.expected_output: Continues through the normal lightweight execution path without demanding a high-risk trace matrix, new IDs, a plan revision or an extra review gate.
expectations: Does not apply the high-risk readiness guard mechanically to a low-risk local change
Preserves the existing direct-or-delegate decision
Does not create new artifacts or owner checkpoints

evals.prompt: 恢复一个 approved attempt。下一 actionable unit 修改 tenant-scoped authorization，但当前 Spec/AC 没有定义允许范围、拒绝语义或 authority fence；plan 写了几个测试名称。请开始执行。
evals.expected_output: Blocks only the affected high-risk unit and routes the missing behavior and acceptance contract to req-align; test names cannot substitute for the absent contract.
expectations: Runs the high-risk verification-readiness guard before execution or dispatch
Routes to req-align because the behavior boundary and Acceptance Semantics are missing
Does not let impl-planning, the executor or existing test names invent the authority contract
Does not broaden the blocker into a new gate for unrelated low-risk units

evals.prompt: 恢复一个 approved attempt。下一 actionable unit 修改 cursor pagination；Spec/AC 边界、描述性 integration test 名称、关键边界场景、oracle 和 ER owner 都能稳定定位，但没有统一 Verification ID。请继续执行。
evals.expected_output: Passes the high-risk verification-readiness guard and continues through the existing execution path without inventing IDs, a matrix artifact or a plan revision.
expectations: Accepts stable semantic anchors and descriptive test names without a uniform ID
Does not create a case matrix or second verification contract
Preserves the normal risk-based execution and review routing

evals.prompt: 真实 E2E 发现两个 consumer 对同一版本化事实不兼容解释。当前业务动作还包含 browser/provider 独有风险。应如何推进？
evals.expected_output: Treats the conflict as a material seam, establishes cheaper faithful evidence retaining real consumers, limits any sweep to semantic neighbours in the current action, and retains E2E for browser/provider-specific risk.
expectations: Does not use producer-only or mock evidence as a substitute for real E2E
Does not create a consumer registry or full-repository sweep
Records actual evidence in ER without a new runtime state

evals.prompt: 人工决定从 UI 经 DTO 和 confirm 到权威提交时被静默丢失；局部字段检查都是绿色。如何调查、修复并验证？
evals.expected_output: Finds the first contract-violating boundary, uses checkpoints to locate the last valid and first invalid assumption, and verifies authority/provenance without fixture or field-name special cases.
expectations: Does not let UI or cached projection alone prove authoritative commit
Repairs an implementation defect when existing contract uniquely decides behaviour
Does not invent an arbitrary-field passthrough framework

evals.prompt: Failure appears only in a real browser lifecycle and native-tool file interaction. Local logic cannot retain that causal mechanism. How should execution proceed?
evals.expected_output: Keeps real E2E as the authoritative evidence, adds only useful readiness or observability, and refuses to present mock or unit success as final acceptance.
expectations: Does not force a lower-level regression that loses the causal mechanism
Does not create a hard E2E admission gate
Records the actual environment evidence in ER

evals.prompt: A provider times out once in E2E and cannot be stably reproduced; the product contract promises no particular retry behavior. What should be recorded and tested?
evals.expected_output: Treats the classification as provisional, improves readiness/runbook/observability as appropriate, and does not manufacture a deterministic code regression test.
expectations: Allows a later purposeful run when it has new diagnostic value
Does not mislabel the incident as an internal logic regression
Does not create a new gate or evidence matrix

evals.prompt: The team cannot distinguish an internal adapter defect from real protocol behavior. A sandbox E2E can produce the decisive response and boundary artifact, but some internal evidence is not yet available. Continue execution.
evals.expected_output: Allows a bounded exploratory E2E with candidate hypotheses, decisive artifact and result routing; it does not claim all preconditions are proven and requires information gain before a repeat run.
expectations: Does not treat missing evidence as a hard E2E admission block
Does not repeat the run without new hypothesis, delta or observation
Keeps diagnostic detail in ER rather than a second Planned Verification contract

evals.prompt: A stable local algorithm boundary bug affects no version compatibility, mapping, authority switch, cross-consumer interpretation or silent information loss. What is the regression path?
evals.expected_output: Uses a faithful local regression and explicitly does not run a seam sweep or expand consumer scope.
expectations: Does not create a matrix or consumer registry
Does not request a new owner decision
Keeps the change on the lightweight path

evals.prompt: The current package claim has complete evidence, but another historical package has an unrelated internal failure with no lower-level regression. Can the current package close?
evals.expected_output: Audits only the current claim-related, confirmed material failure set and does not make the current package pay unrelated historical technical debt.
expectations: Preserves completion audit non-retrospectivity
Does not create a debt registry or broaden verification scope
Reports any current-claim residual risk precisely

evals.prompt: An approved real-provider check fails. The executor adds a control variable and authoritative response checkpoint to distinguish protocol drift from an adapter defect. A variant proposes replacing the required real-provider evidence with a mock for the same completion claim. What is the routing?
evals.expected_output: Appends the diagnostic refinement to ER without P revision in the first case; routes the mock substitution to impl-planning as a verification-strategy change and rejects it as real-provider acceptance evidence.
expectations: Treats failure classification as revisable and potentially multi-causal
Does not create a second Planned Verification contract in ER or execution-findings
Does not use a mock to replace required real-provider acceptance

evals.prompt: 一个跨 consumer seam 的回归测试只有在 production mapper 中按测试 document ID、snapshot hash 和固定时间特判时才会通过。现有 contract 并未赋予这些常量业务语义。应如何修复？
evals.expected_output: Rejects the production fixture special case, keeps the regression focused on the shared representation or invariant, and uses fixture data only as test setup rather than platformizing its constants.
expectations: Does not create a production branch keyed by fixture IDs, hashes or timestamps
Distinguishes fixture constants from domain facts and system invariants
Does not introduce an arbitrary generic framework merely to carry one fixture

evals.prompt: 真实 E2E 已确认版本化 consumer mapping 不一致；修复尚未建立能同时保留两个真实 consumer 的忠实 seam evidence，browser/provider 输入、环境和诊断假设也没有变化。团队要求立刻再跑完整 E2E。应如何推进？
evals.expected_output: Declines the information-free repeat, first establishes the faithful cross-consumer evidence for the confirmed deterministic seam, and keeps a later E2E for its browser/provider-specific residual risk or a new diagnostic delta.
expectations: Does not treat the next full E2E as the first regression for a known internal seam
Does not forbid a later E2E when there is a new hypothesis, delta or environment-specific risk
Does not create a fixed E2E retry count or admission gate

evals.prompt: 现有 Spec 只规定人工 review 必须传递到下游，但没有定义两个会导致不同权威状态和业务结果的结构化表示中哪一个正确。executor 想自行选一个 DTO 映射并补测试。应如何路由？
evals.expected_output: Stops only the affected unit and routes the unresolved business/acceptance semantics to req-align; it does not let the executor, mapper or test choose a shared meaning.
expectations: Distinguishes contract ambiguity from an implementation defect
Does not turn a guessed DTO mapping into a regression oracle
Keeps unrelated low-risk work moving without a new global gate

evals.prompt: 上游 Ticket 仍为 IN_PROGRESS、对应 Task 仍为 RUNNING，但下游依赖的 typed mutation-unknown/cache-clear 行为已提交、有局部测试证据且下游执行基线可用。上游只剩经实际 diff 与 open findings 确认不会改变该行为的真实 caller 并发测试；另一变体中上游仍可能修改 callback、deadline 或错误分类。主 session 能否提前派发下游 Ticket/Task？并行后依赖事实变化又如何处理？
evals.expected_output: Allows only the first variant's downstream Ticket/Task implementation to start from an ER-recorded reusable implementation checkpoint, rejects the seam-changing variant, keeps acceptance/release on their existing gates, and revalidates only affected downstream work if the dependency facts later change.
expectations: Uses the same checkpoint principle for Ticket and Task while preserving SATISFIED versus DONE
Requires committed local evidence and a downstream execution baseline that can use the implementation
Lets the main session append the dispatch rationale to the existing Execution Record without a new state, artifact or checklist
Does not treat implementation dispatch as dependency release or acceptance evidence
Stops using affected downstream work and evidence, marks the related Ticket/Task NEEDS-REVALIDATION, and performs scoped reconciliation when dependency facts change

evals.prompt: 上游 Ticket 已进入 review/revise 循环。code/standards/spec review 只发现一个 docstring P2，修复已提交并有局部证据。变体 A 的 safety review 仍未完成且其范围可能改变 callback、deadline 或并发行为；变体 B 的相关 review 已完成，剩余 closure 只验证不会改变下游依赖 seam 的文档与证据。主 session 在启动下一轮 closure review 前应如何处理下游 implementation？
evals.expected_output: Notices the checkpoint opportunity only because a downstream is blocked and new review evidence suggests its seam may be stable; keeps variant A blocked, but records and dispatches variant B alongside continuing upstream closure without claiming acceptance or dependency release.
expectations: Checks checkpoint readiness only when a downstream is actually blocked and new review/revise evidence suggests its seam is stable
Keeps checkpoint and dispatch judgment with the main session rather than do-review or a leaf reviewer
Treats an incomplete or timed-out relevant review as unresolved seam uncertainty without making unrelated review gaps a blanket blocker
Allows upstream review/closure and downstream implementation to continue in parallel only when the existing checkpoint conditions hold
Does not add a new stage, state or checklist and does not release acceptance or release dependencies
